The 4₁ colored-Jones values at q0 do not land on c_3 under any natural normalisation. The complex / root-of-unity fibre-element lead is therefore ALSO closed for the forced candidates: c_3 anchor-rigidity (real-q falsification, PR #2452 / 2026-06-04 audit) stands.
